sloka: गते हि हरिशार्दूल पुनरागमनाय तु ।प्राणानामपि सन्देहो मम स्यान्नात्र संशयः ।। ५.३९.२२।।।।
transliteration: gate hi hariśārdūla punarāgamanāya tu ।prāṇānāmapi sandeho mama syānnātra saṁśayaḥ ।। 5.39.22।।।।

translations.english: "O tiger among vanaras if you leave this place to come again, my life will be uncertain, (if your coming is uncertain). There is no doubt about it.
